name: Madi Dian
title: Clare Boothe Luce Assistant Professor
department: Aerospace and Mechanical Engineering; Mecharithm Lab
fitReason: Strong computational fit through multimodal representation learning, uncertainty-aware intent decoding, conversational VLA models and physically grounded assistance. Projects connect learned human intent to robot action rather than focusing only on rehabilitation hardware.

physicalEvidence.summary: The July 16, 2026 NeuroCommitSSM paper validates a learned EEG/EMG/eye-tracking model through a real Kinova Gen3 arm, ROS2 and RGB-D feasibility checks. Hardware validation replays 168 held-out biosignal trials; it is not a live closed-loop user-adaptation study. The accompanying human dataset includes 32 adults.

shortVisit.summary: The current personal-page joining section invites SLU-enrolled undergraduate/master’s researchers and SLU PhD applicants. The lab contact page has generic graduate/postdoctoral/undergraduate headings but no explicit external-master’s short-visit route. No summer 2027 visitor opening, funding or self-funded appointment permission was verified.

scoreReasons.fit: learned multimodal intent, VLA and assistive shared autonomy.
scoreReasons.physical: detailed July 2026 Kinova hardware evaluation, with replay limitation explicit.

name: Roberto Tron
title: Associate Professor; Director of Master’s Degree Programs in Robotics and Autonomous Systems
fitReason: Strong methods-oriented HRI fit: learns personalized safety interventions from sparse user demonstrations through differentiable constrained optimization, alongside robotics perception, mapping and data-driven control.

physicalEvidence.summary: The July 21, 2026 Learning from Haptics paper deploys learned safety responses on an actual DJI Tello EDU with a Geomagic Touch interface and OptiTrack. The hardware result is a qualitative deployment demonstration; quantitative preference-matching comparisons use AirSim. The work is not an end-to-end foundation-model policy.

shortVisit.summary: No lab-specific external visitor/intern invitation was found in the verified faculty/research pages. BU’s institutional Short-Term Scholar policy permits qualifying research appointments for people completing a US-master’s-equivalent degree, up to six months, and allows documented personal funds. This does not establish Tron’s availability or a summer 2027 offer.

scoreReasons.fit: human-preference learning plus safe shared control and perception.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: institutional category only, no direct lab invitation.
